posts.title: The breath of the night-wind
posts.description: Parts of my world have burned down and I’m heartbroken and in agony. posts.title: Medical Trauma
posts.description: Nightingale has been stranded in hospital for 8 days. We called an ambulance when her pain, which has been worsening daily for 6 months, finally reached 10/10. posts.title: Lamps that light us home
posts.description: The rain falls steadily outside, through white mist. It runs down the eaves of my house and drips through the gaps in the deck. Underneath the deck waits a partly finished painting, of an Orca in multicoloured waves.
